prompt:

Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.

Message: "I’ve heard some talk that the council might be planning to step up bin enforcement soon, though I’m not sure how true it is. It would be a bit much if they start fining us, but maybe they really are looking to tighten up the rules."
text: The council is officially launching a massive crackdown on our bins and will start hitting everyone with heavy fines immediately. They are completely out of control with these new authoritarian rules.
